items.title: Exploring new features of Apache TinkerPop 3.8.x in Amazon Neptune
items.summary: Upgrading to Apache TinkerPop 3.8.x in Amazon Neptune 1.5.0.0 brings cleaner, more predictable Gremlin and a major expansion of Data Flow Engine (DFE) coverage, along with semantic changes that need review. Learn what changed, which query patterns are affected, and how to prepare for the upgrade.
items.creator: Stephen Mallette
